title: LoopAhead: Speculating Ahead for Faster Decoding in Looped Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.21594v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Looped Transformers improve parameter efficiency by repeatedly applying the same Transformer layers. However, generating each token still involves sequential computation and repeated access to model weights, leading to high decoding latency. Recent pipelined self-speculative decoding methods reduce this delay by drafting tokens from early-loop predictions and asynchronously advancing tokens at different recurrent depths in the same batch, but they do not fully exploit early-loop features for longer lookahead and still spend computation verifying incorrect speculative branches. We introduce \method, a speculative decoding framework for looped transformers that enables earlier drafting of future tokens and assigns complementary roles to different recurrent depths. A lightweight lookahead drafter (LAD) predicts multiple future tokens with early-loop states, and deeper-loop feedback helps decide which draft branches to continue and which to

translated_title: LoopAhead：通过提前推测加速循环语言模型的解码
translated_abstract: 循环Transformer通过重复应用相同的Transformer层来提升参数效率。然而，生成每个token仍然涉及顺序计算和对模型权重的重复访问，导致解码延迟较高。近期的流水线自推测解码方法通过从早期循环预测中起草token，并在同一批次中在不同循环深度异步推进token来减少这种延迟，但它们未能充分利用早期循环特征实现更长的前瞻预测，且仍需花费计算来验证错误的推测分支。我们提出了LoopAhead，一个面向循环Transformer的推测解码框架，它能够更早地起草未来token，并为不同循环深度分配互补的角色。轻量级前瞻起草器（LAD）利用早期循环状态预测多个未来token，而更深层循环的反馈则帮助决定继续哪些草稿分支以及放弃哪些分支。
tldr: LoopAhead是一个面向循环Transformer的推测解码框架，通过轻量级前瞻起草器利用早期循环状态提前预测多个未来token，并结合更深层循环的反馈筛选草稿分支，从而显著降低解码延迟。
en_tdlr: LoopAhead is a speculative decoding framework for looped transformers that uses a lightweight lookahead drafter to predict multiple future tokens from early-loop states and leverages deeper-loop feedback to filter draft branches, significantly reducing decoding latency.
